notes: The Inca Empire had fallen to Spain (1532–1572).
Songhai fell to Morocco at Tondibi (1591).
The Saadi dynasty replaced the Wattasids in 1549.
Royal Hungary (north and west) was Habsburg; Transylvania was an Ottoman vassal principality.
Added the Portuguese captaincies along the Brazilian coast.
Split 'central Asian khanates': the Khalkha/Chahar Mongols, the Oirats, the Yarkent Khanate and the Jurchens.
Akbar had annexed Gujarat (1573), Bengal (1576), Kashmir (1586), Sindh (1591) and Orissa (1592).
Filled unclaimed land with peoples and cultures from neighbouring maps.
Named the remaining unclaimed regions after their regional peoples.

Bavaria, Saxony, Brandenburg, Pomerania, Württemberg, the Electoral Palatinate and the other larger German states have their own territories inside the Holy Roman Empire, and Austria, Bohemia, Silesia and Lusatia are Habsburg lands; outlines are taken from the 1715, 1783, 1800 and 1815 maps and are approximate.
